purpose: Lets a reviewer decide the target type (code, requirement, design, plan, uxui) of each review target and select which criteria and normative documents to read for that type.
summary: Defines five target types: code, requirement, design, plan, uxui; ADR is treated as design
Procedure to resolve doc_type by passing a path to resolve_doc_structure.py, without reading the config file directly
Table mapping doc_type values (plan, requirement, design, adr, null, others) to the next action and target type
Rules for detecting UI-related documents and source code by reading the file, not by name alone
Handling of undetermined targets: use only common documents, no guessing, not a finding or an error
List of common documents applied to every target: generic criteria, review priorities, scope proportionality, error classification
Per-type tables of review criteria, built-in normative documents, project-specific items, and cross-check targets
Stops the review without deciding a type when the config lookup status is not ok
tasks: Reviewing code, requirement, design, plan, or UI/UX documents with a reviewer
Determining the target type of a review target
Selecting which criteria and normative documents to load for a review
Editing or auditing the review criteria document structure
title: レビュー対象の種別と読む文書
